What is Waxlight

Waxlight brings everything around Vintage Story into one desktop app: multiple accounts with TOTP/2FA support, side-by-side game versions, isolated instances with their own mods and settings, a built-in ModDB browser, backups, and playtime tracking.

The project is maintained by AmadoMuerte with help from contributors. Waxlight is not affiliated with the developers of Vintage Story, does not distribute the game, and does not bypass its licensing — a valid Vintage Story account is required to play.

Features

Accounts & sign-in

Multiple Vintage Story accounts with TOTP/2FA and protected session storage.

Game versions

Multiple Vintage Story versions side by side, installed from the official version feed.

Instances

Isolated game environments with their own mods, settings, game version, and account.

Mods & ModDB

A built-in Vintage Story ModDB browser — search, install, and update mods per instance.

Backups & recovery

Snapshots, safety backups before changes, and restoration of a known-good state.

Instance packages

Export and import instances as portable packages with private-data sanitization.

Operations & downloads

Track downloads and long-running work — progress, cancellation, history.

Launcher updates

Stable and prerelease channels, SHA-256 verification, trusted-publisher control.

Policies & security

Waxlight keeps passwords and sessions only in the protected OS store, and telemetry is off by default. Details are in the project policies:

Privacy Policy

What is stored locally, which telemetry may be sent, and which services the launcher contacts.

Security

Threat model, credential storage, and how to report a vulnerability privately.

Code signing

Windows release signing policy via the SignPath Foundation and artifact verification.

For developers

The source code is open (GPL-3.0): Go + Wails 2 on the backend, React 19 + TypeScript on the frontend. Building from source, the layered architecture, tests, and contribution rules are covered in the Development section. The full list of repository documents is on the Repository documents page.
